author: JibinBao

#### Description

<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->
When install sonic image by onie, sometimes it raises error log like "ERR systemd[1]: Failed to start System Logging Service"._

The issue is due to a very rare timing issue, where rsyslog was started by systemd and before starting can complete, ZTP detects /etc/sonic/config_db.json and shuts down all process including rsyslog resulting to a parallel start stop and leading to errors. But eventually rsyslog gets restarted Here is the sequence

Feb  8 17:17:24.084735 sonic INFO systemd[1]: Starting Update rsyslog configuration...
Feb  8 19:17:24.555834 r-tigon-04 INFO systemd[1]: Stopping System Logging Service...
Feb  8 19:17:24.568028 r-tigon-04 INFO systemd[1]: rsyslog.service: Succeeded.
Feb  8 19:17:24.568573 r-tigon-04 INFO systemd[1]: Stopped System Logging Service.
Feb  8 19:17:24.570550 r-tigon-04 INFO systemd[1]: Starting System Logging Service...
Feb  8 19:17:24.573292 r-tigon-04 NOTICE systemd[1]: rsyslog.service: Main process exited, code=exited, status=1/FAILURE
Feb  8 19:17:24.573428 r-tigon-04 WARNING systemd[1]: rsyslog.service: Failed with result 'exit-code'.
Feb  8 19:17:24.574127 r-tigon-04 ERR systemd[1]: Failed to start System Logging Service.
Feb  8 19:17:24.576389 r-tigon-04 INFO sonic-ztp[22060]: Job for rsyslog.service failed because the control process exited with error code.
Feb  8 19:17:24.576477 r-tigon-04 INFO sonic-ztp[22060]: See "systemctl status rsyslog.service" and "journalctl -xe" for details.
Feb  8 19:17:24.600999 r-tigon-04 INFO systemd[1]: ztp.service: Succeeded.
Feb  8 19:17:24.700135 r-tigon-04 INFO systemd[1]: rsyslog.service: Scheduled restart job, restart counter is at 1.
Feb  8 19:17:24.700459 r-tigon-04 INFO systemd[1]: Stopped System Logging Service.
Feb  8 19:17:24.702382 r-tigon-04 INFO systemd[1]: Starting System Logging Service...
Feb  8 19:17:24.703573 r-tigon-04 INFO systemd[1]: rsyslog.service: Succeeded.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Install image by onie
2. Check syslog

#### Describe the results you received:
There is error log raised as below:
**_ERR systemd[1]: Failed to start System Logging Service_**

linkedPullRequests.title: [ztp] Fix race between ztp and rsyslog-config
linkedPullRequests.author: rajendra-dendukuri
linkedPullRequests.body:
- ZTP service restarts rsyslog service when it is shutting down. There
       can be a situation where rsyslog-config service is operational and
       restarting rsyslog.service.

     - The proposed changes start ztp.service after rsyslog-config.service
       exits.

Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/13798

comments.author: rajendra-dendukuri
comments.body:
> @rajendra-dendukuri Isn't the race between rsyslog and ztp and not actually rsyslog-config? From the error log Feb 8 19:17:24.574127 r-tigon-04 ERR systemd[1]: Failed to start System Logging Service. Shouldn't the dependency be on rsyslog.service?

If we were to use After rsyslog.service, the rsyslog.service has already started during bootup. So ztp.service will always run in parallel to rsyslog-config.service. The rsyslog-config.service, internally restarts rsyslog.service. ztp.service also does the same. So the race is between these two (rsyslog-config.service and ztp.service) and its effect is seen on rsyslog.service.
